# Sin <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Sin:Float32 degrees:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `degrees` | In | Float32 | required | The angle in degrees. |

**Returns:** A value from -1 to 1.

## Description

Returns the sine of an angle given in degrees, not radians.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Sin(30)
```

```text
0.5
```
